tier1.text: Each thyrocervical artery carries blood to the thyroid gland, an organ in the neck just below the voice box. This artery also feeds the neck, the upper back and the shoulder. The artery is one of three major branches of the subclavian artery, an artery that feeds the arm and chest.

quotes.quote: The thyroid gland is a very vascular organ that is located in the neck. It consists of two lobes, one on each side of the trachea, just below the larynx or voice box.

quotes.quote: Each subclavian artery supplies blood to the arms, chest, shoulders, back, and central nervous system. It then gives rise to three major branches: the internal thoracic artery, the vertebral artery, and the thyrocervical artery.
